text: 1. Non-criminal record certificate issued by the local police force. 2. A letter of financial support or bank statements of the last six months from parents (including guardians). 3. Application form, passport, transcripts, high school graduation certificate or notarized documents (those who have not graduated at the time of application can provide pre-graduation certificate). 4. TOEFL IBT or lELTS Score Report (if available) (for English-taught program applicants whose native languageis not English) 5. Physical examination form for foreigners (medical examination results valid for 6 months) 6. A passport-size electronic photo taken in the past three months. 7. Other documents that may be required by HZCU to make corrections or submit.
